title: linear_terminating_chain
description: Mo hinh mot TRINH CAI DAT PHAN MEM (setup wizard): 'welcome' -> 'license_agreement' -> 'choose_folder' -> 'installing' -> 'done', hoan toan TUYEN TINH, KHONG CO CHU TRINH nao quay nguoc lai (tru 1 self-loop BAT BUOC tai 'done' de thoa man tinh tong quan he cua R — quy uoc pho bien cho 'trang thai ket thuc'). Vi KHONG co bat ky duong di nao co the 'lan tran' mai ma khong toi 'done', AF(done) LUON DUNG (100% dam bao song con) — DOI LAP HOAN TOAN voi self_loop_retry_livelock.json (noi AF(success) la SAI vi co duong di retry vo han). Hai file nay NEN duoc kiem chung CANH NHAU de thay ro gia tri thuc te cua AF.
